designRead: Reading this as: a useful technology explainer for mobile viewers, using an authored editorial system, with sources as traceable evidence rather than page templates.
audienceThesis: The viewer should understand the core idea, its mechanism, and the main condition without reading the source cards.
visualWorld: A clean editorial workspace where concepts become labeled structures and evidence appears only when it proves a point.
typography: One highly legible CJK sans family establishes hierarchy through weight and size; ordinary Latin text and numbers remain in the same family.
colorLogic: Neutral light background, near-black reading text, green for supported flow, blue for evidence, and red only for limitations.
graphicLanguage: Rules, nodes, brackets, and bounded evidence windows with consistent 4px line weight.
motionGrammar: Ideas assemble spatially, relationships connect directionally, and evidence snaps into the relevant authored structure.
openingFrame: The topic name and central thesis are visible immediately, supported by one recognizable subject cue.
motionThesis: Scattered source facts resolve into one understandable system, then the limiting condition constrains it.
